upcoming.title: Children's Praise Sunday
upcoming.description: A joyful morning of praise led by our children. Come and worship with songs, dance, tambourines and lots of joy as our kids lift up the name of Jesus.

upcoming.title: Bible Quiz Competition
upcoming.description: Classes go head-to-head in a friendly Bible quiz! Teams will answer questions from the lessons we have studied this term. Bring your family and cheer for your class.

upcoming.title: Christmas Family Celebration
upcoming.description: Carols, a Christmas drama, games and a special family lunch. Children are invited to come dressed in their Christmas best as we celebrate the birth of Jesus together.

upcoming.title: End-of-Year Thanksgiving & Party
upcoming.description: We close the year with gratitude! Join us for thanksgiving, class presentations, awards, food and fun as we remember all God has done in 2026.

upcoming.title: New Year Praise & Dedication
upcoming.description: We begin the new year by dedicating our children to God and asking for His wisdom, protection and favour over the year ahead.

past.title: Children's Day Celebration
past.summary: Balloons, bunting and big smiles! Our Children's Day celebration was a beautiful morning of games, prizes, cake and thanksgiving for every child in our church family.

past.title: Vacation Bible School
past.summary: One whole week of Bible stories, songs, crafts and quizzes. Thank you to every teacher and volunteer who made VBS 2026 unforgettable.

past.title: Easter Praise & Drama
past.summary: Our children brought the Easter story to life through drama, music and a powerful testimony of Jesus' resurrection.

past.title: Community Outreach Day
past.summary: Our children and volunteers packed gift boxes and food items for families in our community. It was a joyful day of sharing God's love.
